messages:
grace: Heads-up — the json-qa nightly that ran after the v20c weight push is failing hard. Structured-output pass rate went from ~96.8% yesterday to 85.3% now. Anyone seeing this?
nightly-bot: nightly-evals | model:v20c | promptset:json-qa | pass_rate:85.3% | delta:-11.5pp | failing:42 | tag:structured-schema
leo: seeing it locally too. quick diff vs v19b shows a lot of outputs with wrong keys — e.g. \"answer_text\" instead of \"answer\" — and some outputs missing closing braces.
miriam: note that v20c included tokenizer merge changes (PR #412) and a softmax rescale (commit abcdef12). both landed in the same window.
jordan: was the nightly run using the quantized serving image or the float fallback? yesterday we promoted int4/int8 test builds for perf runs.
leo: metadata from the job: model_variant=int8-serving. so this is from the quantized path.
gr ace: I pulled a few failing examples and did a local gen. sample: 
```
PROMPT: {"task":"json_qa","question":"How many nodes are in a balanced tree of height 3?","schema":{"answer":"int"}}
OUTPUT: {"answer_text": 15,
"confidence": 0.92,
"extra": {"notes":"computed recursively"}
}
```
leo: yep, field name mismatch (answer_text vs answer). validator marks as fail even though numeric value is correct.
miriam: this screams tokenizer boundary shifts to me — merged merges can change token ids for small words and cause the structured-output head (which looks for exact token keys) to pick alternate tokens. softmax scaling could alter generation probabilities too.
jordan: also noticed broader generation-length variance on v20c — more tail tokens, which can trip strict schema decoders if they expect an early end token.
gr ace: triage plan: rerun a small matrix (v19b-float, v20c-float, v20c-int8) on 100 prompts; capture token-level logits and tokenization alignments for failing cases; diff tokenizer vocab between tags; run deterministic decode (temp=0) to see if model can render exact schema keys when forced.
leo: kicking off matrix now: `./scripts/nightly/run_eval.sh --models v19b,v20c,v20c-int8 --promptset json-qa --limit 100` — I'll upload logs when done. :hourglass:
miriam: grabbing vocab diffs: `git diff --word-diff origin/v19b..origin/v20c -- tokenizer/vocab.json` — will paste the token id changes here when I have them.
nightly-bot: job 93458 queued by leo, eta ~14m
jordan: quick check: run one failing case with `--disable-sampling --temperature 0` and see if keys line up. determinism will tell us if this is probabilistic sampling or a hard token/decoder change.
leo: ran temp=0 on 3 fail samples: v19b -> 3/3 produced correct key names; v20c-int8 -> 0/3 produced expected keys. saving logs to /mnt/eval/logs/1748001234/ (include token ids + probs).
miriam: initial vocab diff shows ~17 new merges and ~8 removed merges that change the tokenization around \"answer\" and small connectors. I'll list exact token-id remaps in a follow-up comment.
gr ace: next steps / action items:
- leo: finish the 100-prompt matrix and upload full logs (in progress)
- miriam: paste full token-id mapping and point out tokens that affect our schema keys (in progress)
- jordan: run deterministic/temp=0 decode across the whole 100-set and summarize pass rates
- me (grace): if matrix confirms degradation on the quantized path we should pause the v20c canary and revert the serving tag until root cause is identified. I'll be prepared to open a rollback PR.
ops: acknowledged — stand by for rollback request. :eyes:
leo: if this looks like tokenizer id drift we could try a short-term mitigation: pin tokenizer to v19b for the serving image while keeping weights from v20c. That would help us isolate weight vs tokenization causes.
jordan: also worth testing v20c-float separately — if float v20c produces correct keys but v20c-int8 doesn't, that points to quantization interaction.
miriam: adding to triage — run constrained decoding where we bias generation to emit exact schema tokens first (soft-favor). that'll tell us if the model can still produce the right tokens under mild nudges.
gr ace: thanks all. please post results back here. if anyone finds a smoking gun (token id remap or a quantization-scaling bug), tag infra-eng and ops. :thumbsup:
